Class SbxCli

java.lang.Object
com.mobybank.harness.infrastructure.sbx.SbxCli
public final class SbxCli extends Object
The few sbx commands the harness needs, built as argument lists. Location.CLOUD adds the global --cloud flag, which points the same commands at Docker's hosted sandboxes instead of the local daemon.

      public CommandResult exec(Location target, String sandbox, List<String> inside, Duration timeout, Consumer<String> onStdoutLine)
      Runs a command inside a sandbox. The caller decides what a non-zero exit code means.

    • move

      public void move(String source, Location to, String newName, Duration cloudTtl, Duration timeout)
      Moves a sandbox to the other location with sbx move, which captures the sandbox's filesystem and starts a new sandbox from it at the destination. The destination gets a new id; newName is the name requested for it (a cloud destination always appends a short suffix).
